title: Family by Swimming Pool, 1968 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot taken in September 1968 featuring a family standing poolside in a suburban backyard. A shirtless man in swim trunks, a woman in a floral print summer dress, and a young girl in a swimsuit pose together near the edge of an in-ground pool. The background displays a wooden fence, a sloped yard, and power lines, encapsulating middle-class American leisure and backyard lifestyle during the late 1960s.
